layers.text: Style (retro hacker chic skin): a real place outdoors at night as an old green-screen computer would draw it. Only near-black and phosphor green (bright #33ff66, plus one dim and one dark green step), no other hues. Crisp pixel art: dark silhouettes and flat dark-green shapes with thin 1-2 pixel glowing green edges and sparse lit dots, a faint glow, calm and uncluttered. Backdrop: one wide real landscape seen from a standing person's eye height, like a flat 2D game background, nobody in it, mostly dark and low in contrast so bright, colourful hand-drawn characters placed on top later stand out.

Subject: the edge of a town at night seen across an empty field. The upper half is a dark night sky with long low layered clouds lit faintly green from below by the city, the glow strongest just above the skyline. A little below the middle runs a straight, level horizon: a distant city skyline of office towers, flat blocks, a water tower and a radio mast, dark shapes with dim green lit windows, with low dark hills behind it on the left and right. A row of tall electricity pylons with sagging power lines recedes from the left toward the city, getting smaller. From the horizon down to the bottom edge, a wide, flat, empty field of short dark grass with sparse dim green grass tufts and dithering, a little more detailed toward the bottom, with nothing standing on it.
